Whitby Green.road: Narrow cul-de-sac estate road, no centre line, no markings, block-paved/tarmac drives straight off it, grass amenity verges.
Whitby Green.note: 1970s estate of short terraces and link houses in orange-brown brick with white cladding bands under the upper windows and integral garages, set round open grass and some mature trees.

Micklands Road.road: Quiet residential road, no centre line, double yellow lines near the school end, no humps seen.
Micklands Road.note: Detached red-brick chalet bungalows and bungalows with steep gables and dormers, behind tall hedges and low brick or white rendered walls; lots of garden trees.

Caversham Park Road.road: Wide distributor road with white centre line and arrows, wide grass verges both sides, street lights; houses screened by fences, woods and hedges.
Caversham Park Road.note: Main road through the estate lined mostly by grass verges, woodland and back fences; the few houses glimpsed are set well back behind trees.

Dacre Avenue.road: Estate road, no centre line or markings, dropped kerbs to every drive.
Dacre Avenue.note: 1960s-70s estate: low brown-brick bungalows with long brown concrete-tiled roofs on one side, and semis with white-clad upper floors over brown brick on the other; open-plan fronts and wooden fences.

Woodlands Grove.road: Cul-de-sac with a turning head, no markings, separate footpath, low wooden bollards on grass verges.
Woodlands Grove.note: 1980s executive detached houses in red brick with integral garages, some with dark-brown weatherboarded first floors; open-plan lawns and big oak trees.

Montfort Gate.road: Short block-paved cul-de-sac off Henley Road with no markings; the mouth has double yellow lines and a cycle lane on Henley Road.
Montfort Gate.note: 2000s close of red-brick and cream-rendered detached and semi houses with brick arches over the windows, bay windows and small porches, open lawns and shrubs; 1930s semis visible on Henley Road at the entrance.

Lowfield Green.road: Wide-ish estate road, no centre line or markings, kerbed footways, drives off every house.
Lowfield Green.note: 1970s detached houses in red brick with integral or linked garages, white garage doors, some tile-hung upper fronts, brown concrete-tiled roofs, open-plan lawns and shrub borders.

Corfe Mews.road: Narrow close, no markings, cars parked on drives and kerb.
Corfe Mews.note: Mix of buff-brick bungalows and short terraces of red-brick houses with flat-roofed garages and porches; low brick walls, hedges and gravel fronts.

Hadleigh Rise.road: Sloping estate road, no centre line or markings, block-paved drives.
Hadleigh Rise.note: 1970s link-detached and semi houses in buff/brown brick with white panels under windows, white up-and-over garage doors and brown concrete-tiled roofs, open-plan fronts on a slope.

Bramber Mews.road: Narrow estate close, no markings; the first view is on Caversham Park Road (bus route) with a wide grass verge and woodland.
Bramber Mews.note: 1970s estate: terraces of low red-brick bungalows with grey concrete-tiled roofs and white fascias, plus buff-brick two-storey houses; open grass fronts and fences.

Lomond Avenue.road: Estate road with no centre line, heavy on-street and verge parking, gravel and block-paved hardstandings in front gardens.
Lomond Avenue.note: 1960s-70s estate terraces in red and orange-brown brick with white weatherboard panels and canopy porches, low-pitched concrete-tile roofs, open fronts turned into parking; occasional verge trees.

Framlingham Drive.road: Estate road, no centre line, no markings; footway on one side, communal green with small trees at the end.
Framlingham Drive.note: 1970s terraces and semis in buff/brown brick with white weatherboard panels between storeys, integral garages and brown concrete roofs; open lawns, low fences and a communal green.

Pendennis Avenue.road: Estate road meeting Caversham Park Road; yellow school zig-zags and double yellows at the junction, school warning sign, wide grass verge with young trees on the main road.
Pendennis Avenue.note: 1970s estate of buff-brick terraces and red-brick semis with integral garages and some tile-hung or clad upper fronts, brown concrete roofs, open-plan fronts and wooden ranch fences, next to the school.

Abbottsleigh Gardens.road: Quiet cul-de-sac, no markings, footways both sides, block-paved drives.
Abbottsleigh Gardens.note: 1990s-2000s executive detached houses in red brick with steep front gables, brick arches, integral garages and dark/brown plain-tile roofs; open lawns, shrubs, brick-pier-and-fence corner walls.

Eltham Avenue.road: Estate road with white give-way/edge dashes at the junction, no centre line along the street, block-paved drives.
Eltham Avenue.note: 1970s link-detached houses in orange-brown brick with flat-roofed garages, canopy porches and brown concrete-tiled roofs set on open-plan corner lawns.

Montpelier Drive.road: Curving estate road with white centre dashes and double yellow lines on the bend.
Montpelier Drive.note: Only 2 of 4 views loaded. 1970s buff and brown brick semis and link houses with white-clad panels, integral garages and open lawns; fences on the side gardens.

Maytree Walk.road: Narrow cul-de-sac with no markings, block-paved drives straight off it, footway one side.
Maytree Walk.note: 1990s-2000s cul-de-sac of detached red-brick houses with steep gables, white plastic windows, small porch canopies and integral or side garages; open lawns, clipped shrubs and brick-pier fence walls at the side.

Littlestead Close.road: Curving estate road and cul-de-sac turning head, no centre line, wide grass corner verges with birch and willow trees.
Littlestead Close.note: 1970s estate of brown-brick detached houses and chalet bungalows, some with white-boarded first floors and integral garages, set back on open lawns with low brick walls and hedges.

Launceston Avenue.road: Estate road, no centre line, grass verge strips, block-paved drives.
Launceston Avenue.note: 1970s buff-brick semis and short terraces with white panel bands under the upper windows, flat-roofed/lean-to porch and garage fronts, open lawns and low buff-brick walls.

Goodrich Close.road: Short sloping cul-de-sac, no markings, grass verges with low kerbs; cars park on the verge.
Goodrich Close.note: 1970s buff-brick estate houses, some with flat-roofed single-storey garage/porch wings and plain gable ends; red-brick semis opposite; open grass fronts with a few hedges and fence panels. (1_* views snapped to the same pano as 0_*.)

Norman Road.upper: white_render over red brick ground floor
Norman Road.road: Narrow residential road, no centre line, overhead phone wires on poles, many fronts paved for parking, dropped kerbs.
Norman Road.note: 1930s hipped-roof semis, mostly white or cream rendered (some render over a red-brick ground floor), with bay windows, small tiled porch canopies and chimneys; fronts largely paved for cars with a few low brick walls and hedges.

Highbridge Close.road: Long straight estate road, no centre line or markings, block-paved drives and open lawns to the footway.
Highbridge Close.note: 1970s estate of short terraces and semis in buff and brown brick with white cladding bands under the upper windows and flat-roofed porch/garage fronts; open-plan lawns, a few fences and hedges, mature garden trees.

Wilwyne Close.note: Google says 'No Street View imagery available here' at both view points (all 4 views); probably a private close with no coverage.

Lady Jane Court.note: Google says 'No Street View imagery available here' at both view points (all 4 views); probably a private close with no coverage.

Northbrook Road.road: Wide estate distributor road with a white edge/centre line, grass verges, railings along a parking court; houses mostly set back behind tall hedges and trees.
Northbrook Road.note: Green, leafy road: tall conifer and laurel hedges and big oaks line it, with a brick community building and glimpses of brown-brick 1970s terraces and a parking court behind railings; few house fronts face the road.

Kendal Avenue.road: Estate road, no centre line, block-paved drives off dropped kerbs, cars parked on drives.
Kendal Avenue.note: 1970s orange-brown brick semis and link houses with flat-roofed garage links and white-framed porches; front gardens behind lap-fence and trellis panels with brick piers, plus shrubs and small trees.

Ibstone Avenue.road: Narrow estate cul-de-sac, no markings, gravel and tarmac drives, carports.
Ibstone Avenue.note: 1970s orange-brown brick terraces and semis with white panels between the upper windows, flat-roofed garages and carports; fronts mix shrubs, gravel drives and trellis-topped fences.

Cawsam Gardens.upper: white/cream render over red-brick ground floor
Cawsam Gardens.road: Residential road, no centre line, overhead phone wires on poles, many fronts paved for parking.
Cawsam Gardens.note: 1930s hipped-roof semis with two-storey bays and chimneys; typically red-brick ground floor with white or cream render above, some fully rendered; small tiled porch canopies, low red-brick front walls and paved drives.

Kildare Gardens.road: Narrow residential road, no centre line, overhead phone wires on poles, fronts mostly paved for parking.
Kildare Gardens.note: 1930s hipped-roof semis, mostly white rendered with red tile-hung panels between the bay windows, some red-brick or buff-brick; chimneys, low red-brick walls with hedges and paved drives.

Dumbarton Way.road: Curving estate road, no centre line, wide grass amenity slopes with trees and street lamps, concrete drives.
Dumbarton Way.note: 1970s orange-brown brick terraces and semis with white boarded bands under the upper windows, integral garages and pent canopies; open lawns and close-board fences to side gardens, big grassy open space beside the road.

Redberry Close.road: Narrow cul-de-sac, no markings, cars parked along the kerb, block paving and tarmac drives.
Redberry Close.note: 1970s buff and light-brown brick semis and short terraces with integral or linked garages and pent porch roofs; some white-clad upper panels; open fronts, close-board side fences and a few hedges.

Earlsfield Close.road: Sloping cul-de-sac, no markings, grass verge strips, block-paved and tarmac drives.
Earlsfield Close.note: 1970s buff-brick link houses and semis on a slope, with integral garages, some white-boarded upper fronts and solar panels; low buff-brick front walls topped by hedges, wooded backdrop.

Pevensey Avenue.road: Estate road, no centre line, block-paved drives and grass strips, cars parked on drives.
Pevensey Avenue.note: 1970s buff-brick link-detached houses with integral garages and steep front gables, plus buff-brick terraces with tiled pent porches; open lawns, hedges and block-paved drives.

Quantock Avenue.road: Estate road, no centre line, block-paved drives, grass strips; mature garden trees overhang the footway.
Quantock Avenue.note: 1970s brown-brick semis and terraces, some with white-rendered or white-clad upper floors, integral garages and pent porch roofs; fronts a mix of block paving, picket and lap fences, hedges and big shrubs.

Tenby Avenue.road: Estate road, no centre line, gravel and concrete drives, footway on the house side.
Tenby Avenue.note: 1970s red/brown brick link-detached houses with front gables and linked garages on one side, and a brown-brick terrace with white panel inserts and integral garages on the other; open lawns, gravel drives and lap fences.

Overton Drive.road: Newish estate road with a white edge line and footway one side, tight bends, block-paved drives; older road at the entrance with tall hedges.
Overton Drive.note: 2000s red-brick estate of detached houses and a block of flats with dormers, tile porch canopies and integral garages, clipped low hedges; at the entrance older white-rendered and red-brick 1930s semis behind tall hedges and fences.

Kirkham Close.road: Cul-de-sac off a road with a dashed give-way/centre line at the junction, block-paved drives, hedges on the corner.
Kirkham Close.note: 1970s buff/light-brown brick link-detached houses with gable fronts, integral garages and pent porches; block-paved fronts with planting, tall clipped hedges on the corner plots.

Ulster Close.road: Cul-de-sac with a central grass island, no markings, gravel and block drives, cars on drives.
Ulster Close.note: 1970s terraces and semis in orange-brown and buff brick, some with white-rendered upper floors, tiled pent porches and integral garages, round a grass turning circle; open gravel fronts with hedges and lap fences.

Devon Drive.upper: brown tile-hung/vertical tiles and white cladding
Devon Drive.road: Narrow estate road, no markings, block-paved drives straight off it, cars parked on the kerb.
Devon Drive.note: 1970s buff and brown brick estate houses with plain gables, some brown tile-hung upper fronts and white panels, single-storey links; fronts with low brick walls, lap fences and block paving.

George Close.note: No Street View pano at either view point (black viewer, no address, same as neighbouring Wilwyne Close and Lady Jane Court); probably a private close with no coverage.

Farnham Drive.road: Service road off the estate distributor leading to a car park and garage blocks, no markings, grass banks and big trees.
Farnham Drive.note: 1970s buff-brick terraces with integral garages and some white cladding behind close-board fences, plus a pale brick flat-roofed block (local shops/offices) with an external stair and garage court; very leafy with grass banks.

Blackwater Close.road: Sloping cul-de-sac, no markings, block-paved and gravel drives, concrete lamp posts.
Blackwater Close.note: 1970s buff-brick semis and terraces with white weatherboarded upper floors and integral garages; low buff-brick front walls with pierced screen-block panels, shrubs and conifers. (Imagery 2012.)

Odiham Avenue.road: Estate road, no markings, block-paved drives, grass strips at the kerb.
Odiham Avenue.note: 1970s buff/light-brown brick semis and short terraces with integral garages and tiled pent canopies over door and garage; fronts paved for parking with close-board fences and hedges between plots.

Raglan Gardens.road: Narrow residential road, no centre line, overhead phone wires on poles, fronts mostly gravelled or paved for parking.
Raglan Gardens.note: 1930s hipped-roof semis with bays and chimneys: red-brick ground floor with white render above, red tile-hung bands between bay windows, some fully rendered; low red-brick walls with piers and gates, gravel drives.

Onslow Gardens.road: Residential road, no centre line, overhead phone wires on poles, gravel and paved drives.
Onslow Gardens.note: 1930s hipped-roof semis with chimneys and bays, white render over red-brick ground floors, some with dark-stained boarded/half-timbered panels on the bays; low red-brick walls with piers, iron gates, hedges and gravel drives, prefab garages.
